name: Camping 101: Alchemy

narrative.details:
So, you chose to cook up brews and potions as an Alchemist. I'm sure that'll come in handy in your travels.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Whuut in Orgrimmar to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
narrative.offerRewardText: There ya have it, directions for your very own Mana Well. Most folks don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to try it out.No camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those as the basis of your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. Check in with someone who can train you in cooking if you haven't already learned the basics.
